title: docs(readme): migration notice — Object UI now lives in objectstack ui/, this repository is archived
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoP5hmR9s2hEkJ3JQG52fKxW)_

Part of objectstack#25854 (step 4) · epic objectstack#25677.

## What

The README now opens with the migration notice (+20 lines, nothing else changed):

- the code lives in objectstack-ai/objectstack `ui/`, imported from this repository's last `main` commit `9e1fe03286` by objectstack#25825;
- the history before the import stays here: objectstack took the tree as one squashed commit, and the maintainer ruled content-only (ruling 31 = A, 2026-10-26), so this repository is archived and never deleted;
- porting an unmerged branch: `git format-patch 9e1fe03286..<branch> --stdout`, then `git am --directory=ui` in objectstack;
- issues were transferred to objectstack (label `domain:ui`) and their old links redirect;
- `@object-ui/*` keeps its names and publishes from objectstack's release lane at the same version as `@objectstack/*`, starting with 18.2.0.

The notice text was approved on the card by the epic PM before this PR opened.

## Merge

This is the last PR into objectui `main`, which has been frozen since 2026-10-25 15:40Z. The freeze lifts for this one PR, and **the maintainer merges it** before clicking Archive (Settings → Danger Zone → **Archive**, not delete).

## Checks run

- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: no changeset owed (README only, no published source).
- Links: every objectstack target (`tree/main/ui`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `ui/CONTRIBUTING.md`) exists on objectstack `main` `e167956e3f`.
